dedupe_keys.name: nyc department of buildings permit issuance

description: The DOB Permit Issuance dataset lists permits issued by the New York City Department of Buildings for construction and demolition work. Applications fall into job types for new buildings, demolitions and alterations of types 1, 2 and 3; each job can have several work types such as general construction, boiler, elevator and plumbing, each with its own permit, and each row follows the life cycle of one permit for one work type. The dataset is updated daily with new and changed records, and was last updated on 25 September 2026 when read; job-level details sit in the companion DOB Job Application Filings dataset. Coverage: New York City. Access: free CSV, JSON and Socrata API. Licence: NYC Open Data terms. Caveats: a permit does not show that the work was completed, and job details must be joined from the filings dataset. Simulation uses are tracking new construction, demolition and major alterations to update building stock and exposure models. Related records: NYC DOB violations and DOB NOW facade filings, and NYC PLUTO.
